questions.question: Which are common configurations for geographically centralized or distributed trade finance IT systems according to the slides?
options: Fully centralized: a single trade finance IT system instance processes transactions for all international operations
Centralized multi-instance: multiple instances run in parallel, one for each country served, all in one physical location
Distributed multi-instance: multiple instances run in parallel and each instance is physically located within the country it serves
No-instance: no trade finance IT system is used at any location
questions.explanation: p.36 列出 common configurations（常见配置）：Fully centralized（完全集中）single instance（单一实例）for all international operations（所有国际业务）；Centralized multi-instance（集中多实例）multiple instances parallel（多个实例并行），one for each country served（每个服务国家一个），all in one physical location（都在一个物理地点）；Distributed multi-instance（分布式多实例）multiple instances parallel and each physically located within country served（每个实例位于所服务国家）。D 不是列出配置。
questions.source: p.36: 'Fully centralized / Centralized multi-instance / Distributed multi-instance'

questions.question: The slides state that in a distributed multi-instance configuration, each trade finance IT system instance is physically located within the country that it serves.
options: 正确
错误
questions.explanation: p.36 说 Distributed multi-instance（分布式多实例）中 multiple instances run in parallel（多个实例并行），and each instance is physically located within the country that it serves（每个实例物理上位于所服务国家）。因此判断正确。
questions.source: p.36: 'each instance is physically located within the country that it serves'

questions.question: Which fraud prevention measures are listed in the slides?
options: Trade Finance Registries help banks prevent duplicate financing fraud
AI helps detect fraud by analyzing patterns and inconsistencies between documents
SGTraDex enables secure sharing of supply chain information
Using only forged L/Cs to speed up processing
questions.explanation: p.37 说 Trade Finance Registries（贸易融资登记处）help banks prevent duplicate financing fraud（防止重复融资欺诈）；AI（人工智能）helps detect fraud（检测欺诈）by analyzing patterns and inconsistencies between documents（分析文件间模式和矛盾）；SGTraDex enables secure sharing of supply chain information（安全共享供应链信息）。D 是欺诈行为，不是防范措施。
questions.source: p.37: 'Trade Finance Registries / AI helps detect fraud / SGTraDex'

questions.question: How does duplicate financing occur in trade finance fraud according to the slides?
options: Through cloned bills of lading
Through using original L/Cs only once
Through sharing supply chain information via SGTraDex
Through annual credit line reviews
questions.explanation: p.37 说 Duplicate financing（重复融资）occurs through cloned bills of lading（通过克隆/伪造提单）。Trade Finance Registries（贸易融资登记处）可帮助 prevent duplicate financing fraud（防止重复融资欺诈）。
questions.source: p.37: 'Duplicate financing occurs through cloned bills of lading'

questions.question: Which statements about fintech in trade finance are correct according to the slides?
options: Fintech companies provide automated supply chain finance platforms
Fintech platforms help connect SMEs with more financing sources
Digital platforms streamline trade documentation and payment processes
Banks partner with Fintech companies to reach global markets
questions.explanation: p.38 说 Fintech companies（金融科技公司）provide automated supply chain finance platforms（自动化供应链金融平台）；Fintech platforms help connect SMEs（中小企业）with more financing sources（更多融资来源）；digital platforms streamline trade documentation and payment processes（简化贸易文件与支付流程）；banks partner with Fintech companies（与金融科技公司合作）to reach global markets（进入全球市场）。四项均正确。
questions.source: p.38: 'automated supply chain finance platforms / connect SMEs / streamline trade documentation / partner with Fintech companies'

questions.question: The slides state that blockchain technology enables real-time supply chain data synchronization.
options: 正确
错误
questions.explanation: p.38 最后一句写 Blockchain technology enables real-time supply chain data synchronization（区块链技术实现实时供应链数据同步）。因此判断正确。
questions.source: p.38: 'Blockchain technology enables real-time supply chain data synchronization'
